title: duscope_query
description: The arguments of duscope_query, which runs `duscope query --no-scan --scan ID --sql SQL`.

sql.description: One SELECT over the scan's tables, which duscope_schema lists; :root_id and :root_last name the path's entry and the last id under it. Without a LIMIT, 25 rows; with one, at most 10000

scan_id.description: The saved scan to read: an id duscope_scan or duscope_scans gave (its first 4 or more characters will do), of a root or a directory under one. Default, or latest: the newest saved scan of a directory under the roots that holds the path

path.description: The entry :root_id names, under one of the server's roots: absolute, or relative to the scan's root. Default: the scan's root, or the server's root when it has one
